newsitem.title: USA: Biocontrol HIV study shows viral reduction.
newsitem.headline: Biocontrol HIV study shows viral reduction.

text.p: Biocontrol Technology Inc said Friday that its subsidiary IDT Inc, in conjunction with HemoCleanse Inc of West Lafayette, Ind., released six-month results of HIV study patients which showed reduction of patient viral levels.

These patients participated in the companies' July 1996 non-randomized study involving extracorporeal whole-body hyperthermia (WBH) utilizing the BioLogic-HT System and disposables for the treatment of HIV.
Biocontrol said the results suggest WBH could extend the clinical effectiveness of multi-drug therapies once a patient began developing drug resistance.
Biocontrol said IDT has received Institutional Review Board approval with a major hospital in Miami, Fla., to commence the companies' FDA-approved three-site study involving a total of 60 patients.

At this first site, Biocontrol said, the Clinical Investigator, who is a leading Miami infectious disease physician specializing in HIV treatment, has been selected and patients for the study will be taken from the Miami area.
Biocontrol said it anticipates the study will begin within the next 60 days.
